# Enterprise Renewal and Services Addendum

Counterparty: Northwind Analytics LLC

Effective Date: 2026-04-01

Jurisdiction: Delaware

Term and Termination. The renewal term is 12 months. Either party may terminate the agreement with forty-five (45) days written notice after the initial stabilization period.

Operational Review. The vendor must deliver a quarterly controls review and attach the incident trend appendix with each renewal checkpoint.
